summary: Uniform notation/sign conventions for the method paper: 13-row table (signature, units, covariant geodesics, k_t=-1 normalization, ray orientation, camera axes, IEEE/IAU Stokes, invariants, LD85 transfer matrix, rho_Q/rho_V, j/alpha symbols, R_high/R_low, MC weights) with code file:line and source mappings; revtex-compiling macros. OPEN-1 ray time-orientation, OPEN-2 Q-basis sign flip.

Five paper figures (pipeline schematic, exact-Kerr disk, polarized GRMHD torus IQUV, Z4c BBH capture phase space, performance from benchmarks.md) re-plotted from saved outputs into paper/figures with scripts in paper/scripts and per-figure provenance in CAPTIONS.md (paper commit 22360ea)

README caption of torus_IQUV.png (AthenaK torus, a=0.9) disagrees with fig_examples.jl (PolishDoughnut, a=0.94).
